entities.summary: Denmark was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2014 with the song "Cliche Love Song", written by Lasse Lindorff, Kim Nowak-Zorde, Daniel Fält, and Basim, and performed by Basim himself. The Danish participating broadcaster, Danmarks Radio (DR), organised the national final Dansk Melodi Grand Prix 2014 in order to select its entry for the contest. In addition, DR was also the host broadcaster and staged the event at B&W Hallerne in Copenhagen, after winning the previous edition with the song "Only Teardrops" by Emmelie de Forest.
